The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's at step 13. It treated the PDF viewer page from step 12 as a downloaded document, even though WebSurfer had only clicked "PDF" and the Download button was never pressed. Its later instructions to search "the downloaded PDF" (steps 14 and 17) rested on that false premise, which led to the 404 errors and the stalled run.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 13
